name: Sprite Swarm

items.name: Glaring Glow
items.text: Many of the sprites in the swarm glow with a painful intensity. All other creatures in a 5-foot emanation (including those in the sprite's space) must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save save or become Dazzled for 1 minute.

items.name: Spark Bombardment
items.text: In unison, several sprites hurl tiny, hot sparks at a creature within 20 feet, dealing 5d4 fire damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Spritely Steal
items.text: The sprites rummage through the possessions of a single creature within their space, attempting a Thievery check check against the creature's Reflex DC. On a success, the sprites take one item of negligible or light Bulk that the creature is carrying but not holding, nor can the item be readied. On a critical success, the item can be one that is held or readied, such as a weapon or potion.

items.name: Swarming Needles
items.text: The sprites swing tiny rapiers and other pointy weapons to deal 3d6 piercing damage to each enemy in the swarm's space (DC 22 basic Reflex save save).

text:
Individually and upon first impression, many sprites seem to be cute and harmless. However, should they get angry or feel the need to act en masse, they gather together into a dangerous swarm. Wielding needles or simply brandishing sharp teeth or claws, a swarm of sprites can catch the unwary by fatal surprise.

---
Elusive, flighty, and ebullient, sprites are what many villagers first imagine when they hear the terms "fey" or "fairy."
